title: Verify navigation and successful contact form submission
steps: Click the 'Who We Are' link in the navigation menu.
Click the 'Contact Us' link to scroll to the form section.
Type 'Interested in Salesforce consulting.' into the 'Comment or Message' field.
Click the 'Submit' button to send the contact request.
expected: The form is submitted successfully and a confirmation message or redirection occurs.
intent: proves the main navigation works and the primary contact form accepts valid data
whyItMatters: If this breaks, visitors cannot explore the site or reach out to start a project, which is the primary goal of the website.

title: Submit contact form with required email empty
expected: A validation error message appears and the form does not submit.
intent: proves the form cannot be sent without the required email address
whyItMatters: If this breaks, someone could send you a message but you would have no way to contact them back, losing the lead entirely.
checklistTitle: Submit with all required fields empty

title: Internal page navigation to Partners
steps: Click the 'Partners' link in the navigation menu.
expected: The browser navigates to the 'https://thinkvibes.com/home-3/partners/' page.
intent: proves the Partners link correctly navigates away from the home page
whyItMatters: If these links fail, the website feels broken and untrustworthy to anyone looking for more detailed information.

title: Newsletter subscription with blank input
steps: Ensure the 'Enter your e-mail address' field is empty.
expected: The application prevents submission and prompts for an email address.
intent: proves the newsletter form does not attempt to subscribe an empty string
whyItMatters: If this breaks, your mailing list will be cluttered with empty entries, wasting your money on storage for non-existent users.
